meta_data.base_class: Retrieve a <meteorological variable> forecast for a specific location and time frame - these variables are quantifiable weather indicators sharing the same input structure.

tool_template.name: <class>_forecast
tool_template.description: Retrieve a <class> forecast for a specific location and time frame.

location.description: The city that you want to get the <class> forecast for.

days.description: Number of days for the forecast.

confidence_level.description: The confidence level percentage for the <class> forecast, indicating the certainty of the forecasted data.

include_historical_data.description: Whether to include historical data in the <class> forecast to enhance accuracy (true or false).

data_source.description: The source from which the <class> forecast data is retrieved, e.g., 'NOAA', 'Weather.com'.

time_interval.description: Interval between forecast data points, such as 'hourly', '3-hourly', or 'daily' (maximum).
